items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: When I played with Harry Shields, he played great, man.

ctx.x: That's something I don't know what they're in here about.

No, I'll tell you about Paul. Paul don't play too much in town. He played on, which was the later year, it was called the Foreign Dance Store, 10-15 I would go, see? They played Paul and Rap and Oscar Marco, see? Then they went to Chicago and played at the Fry's Inn, the rhythm came up, that's when they made those records. They played the Tin Roof, Maple Leaf Rag, and Mellow Boy George, you know? That's when they got famous after, see? And the big shot like Benny Goodman, used to come around Fry's Inn to hear rap…
